DragonShrineElderGreetingText:
Hm… Good to see
you here.

No need to explain
why you came.

CLAIR sent you
here, didn't she?

That girl is a
handful…

I am sorry, but I
must test you.

Not to worry, you
are to answer only a few questions.

Ready?
DragonShrineQuestion2Text:
What helps you to
win battles?
DragonShrineQuestion3Text:
What kind of
trainer do you wish to battle?
DragonShrineQuestion4Text:
What is most
important for raising #MON?
DragonShrineQuestion5Text:
Strong #MON.
Weak #MON.

Which is more
important?
DragonShrinePassedTestText:
Hm… I see…

You care deeply
for #MON.

Very commendable.

That conviction is
what is important!

{PLAYER}, don't
lose that belief.

It will see you
through at the #MON LEAGUE.
DragonShrineMustIInformLanceText:
CLAIR!

This child is
impeccable, in skill and spirit!

Admit defeat and
confer the RISING- BADGE!

…Or must I inform
LANCE of this?
DragonShrineElderScoldsClairText:
CLAIR…

Reflect upon what
it is that you

lack and this
child has.
DragonShrineComeAgainText:
Come again, if you
so desire.
DragonShrineTakeThisDratiniText:
Hm… Good to see
you here.

Your arrival is
most fortunate.

I have something
for you.

Take this DRATINI
as proof that I

have recognized
your worth.
DragonShrineSymbolicDragonText:
Dragon #MON are
symbolic of our clan.

You have shown
that you can be

entrusted with
one.
DragonShrineClairsGrandfatherText:
CLAIR appears to
have learned an

invaluable lesson
from you.

I thank you as her
grandfather.
DragonShrineRivalIsInTrainingText:
A boy close to
your age is in training here.

He is much like
CLAIR when she was

younger. It is a
little worrisome…
DragonShrineWrongAnswerText1:
Hah? I didn't
quite catch that…
DragonShrineElder2Text:
It's been quite
some time since a

trainer has gained
our MASTER's rare approval.

In fact, not since
Master LANCE.
DragonShrineElder3Text:
You know young
Master LANCE?

He looks so much
like our MASTER did in his youth.

It's in their
blood.
DragonShrineClairYouPassedText:
So how did it go?

I guess there's no
point in asking.

You did fail?



…What? You passed?
DragonShrineClairYoureLyingText:
You're lying!

Even I haven't
been approved!
DragonShrineHereRisingBadgeText:
Here, this is the
RISINGBADGE…

Hurry up! Take it!
DragonShrineRisingBadgeExplanationText:
RISINGBADGE will
enable your

#MON to use the
move for climbing waterfalls.

Also, all #MON
will recognize you

as a trainer and
obey your every

command without
question.
